title: 晨练
art_direction: At early morning on a simple earthen mountain courtyard, the old Taoist practices a gentle unarmed movement alone, fully clothed and with feet close to the earth. Repeated overlapping footprints on damp ground form a modest circular path around the place where he practices. His concentration is sincere rather than aggressive. Distant trees and mist are quiet; no other people or dramatic supernatural effects. Wide scene, clear silhouette, blue-gray and warm earth tones.
